Local libASPL changes, October 23, 2026
Object.cpp: NotifyPropertiesChanged dispatches host calls asynchronously through HostCallbacks.hpp.
Device.cpp: RequestDeviceConfigurationChange uses the same queue.
HostCallbacks.hpp: separate serial dispatch queue; captured objects retain their lifetime and notifications own their addresses.
Reason: an actual macOS 27 stack report shows that synchronous host notification from Stream.SetIsActive deadlocks the driver/Core Audio.
StudioPatch's CoreTests.cpp checks that the setter returns before the host finishes notification.
This is a local fix, not an upstream change.

2026-10-23: RequestConfigurationChange now handles an immediate host rejection by calling AbortConfigurationChange, so application-level completion state does not remain pending forever for a rejected request. Callback retains a Device-typed shared pointer. Covered by testInitializeAndRejectedChanges.
